workload_work_year_days_001.answer: 192 days for 10-month ET-15 Teachers; 210 days for 11-month ET-15/11 Teachers; 228 days for 12-month ET-15/12 Teachers.
workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: The work year for 10-month ET-15 Teachers shall be one hundred ninety-two (192) days... The work year for eleven-month Teachers shall be two hundred ten (210) days. The work year for twelve-month Teachers shall be 228 days.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: 7.5 consecutive hours (7:30 AM to 4:30 PM) for ET-15 and ET-15/12 Teachers; 40-hour workweek for EG-09 Teachers.
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: The work day for ET-15 and ET-15/12 Teachers shall be seven-and-one-half (7.5) consecutive hours beginning no earlier than 7:30 AM and ending no later than 4:30 PM... The workweek for EG-09 Teachers shall be forty (40) hours.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: The Parties agree that planning periods shall be used for instructional purposes: planning lessons, reviewing student work, maintaining student records, holding conferences, and other similar activities.

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: 225 minutes per week for elementary teachers; at least 5 daily planning periods per week equal to a class period for secondary teachers.
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: All Teachers serving in elementary schools shall receive two hundred twenty-five (225) minutes per week for planning periods. / All secondary school teachers shall be given at least five (5) daily planning periods per week that are equal in length to a class period...

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: planning periods shall be used for instructional purposes: planning lessons, reviewing student work, maintaining student records, holding conferences, and other similar activities. / In instances where a special subject Teacher is not available to provide coverage for a Teacher’s scheduled planning period, the building Supervisor shall: Seek a substitute; Utilize an alternative planning schedule...

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: each Teacher shall have a duty-free lunch period equal in length to a full teaching period... A duty-free lunch period shall not include the supervision of students. / each Teacher shall have a minimum forty-five (45) minute, duty-free, uninterrupted lunch period each day... During the duty-free lunch period, a Teacher shall not be required to monitor students...
